title: Early Evening Greek Peas Avgolemono
description: A traditional Greek dish featuring roasted peas in a rich avgolemono sauce served in a dolsot stone bowl. This recipe is perfect for a comforting evening meal.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the frozen peas and cook until thawed, about 2-3 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, heat the chicken broth over low heat, or in a bain-marie, until warm.
In a bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and lemon juice until smooth.
Temper the egg yolk mixture by slowly pouring the warm broth into the bowl, whisking continuously.
Strain the sauce into the saucepan with the peas and bring to a simmer.
Season with pepper and salt to taste.
Serve the avgolemono sauce over the peas, garnished with chopped parsley and serve in a dolsot stone bowl.
